The '''Great Sea of Artorias''' was a large ocean on [[Artorias]]. It was at least several kilometers deep. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Artorian government built a [[Artorian safe haven|domed shelter]] at the bottom of the sea. [[Turtle/Legends|Turtles]] swam in the ocean.
